title: Wag Walk Session Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder cam detections, plant/soil sensors (`plant:sensor`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wag:walk
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by walker_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Wag walk session data has stopped arriving for a given walker.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per walker and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gently when one part of your Wag walk session feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
